decision.adopted: Native harvested item writer omits only actual default barrel state and the empty default-capacity tank. Full world persistence is unchanged.
source_rules: Original barrel item writer saves nonzero mode, nonzero sealed progress and fluid data
FluidTankGT writes fluid only if present and retained filter or positive amount
Cover parent writer retains attached covers
Logistics barrel keeps its fluid identity when drained
platform_choices: Minecraft NBT/data components remain in native platform code; no new shared domain rule required
Preserve port-specific nondefault body temperature, cached duration and custom capacity rather than silently discarding existing state
Omit Neo mandatory block-entity id only when there is no actual item data; data-bearing items retain their correct type id
Do not relax ItemMaterialRegistry generic arbitrary storage data guard
Unknown serializable native attachments and covers remain in saved item data
Forge only: omit typed empty ForgeCaps/ForgeData wrappers; keep nonempty or unexpected-type values and keep generic storage guard unchanged
Both loaders omit only the native byte-typed false gt.painted marker; true paint and RGB remain data-bearing and retained
decision.comparisons: _w retains original sparse item writer; brokestar barrel snapshot has cut sealed-fermentation persistence and does not supply an equivalent harvested-item writer here; cruciblecraft stores a different tank profile/plugin multiblock schema, whose base tank block cannot construct the ordinary barrel entity. Preserve existing native tanks and original rules.
unchanged: full world storage keys and capacity
cover harvest capture and duplicate suppression

remaining: Independent actual world restart and old-save migration
Custom external attachments/providers with data components
Original generic Wood/logistics material hull accounting
Ambient nondefault body temperature intentionally remains protected item data; this batch does not remove that port field
